build_bbox_transform: build a python module to compute normalized bounding box transformation targets from expected and ground truth ROIs
build_bbox_transform_batch: build a python module to compute batched bounding box transformation targets for 2D or 3D ROI tensors
build_bbox_transform_inv: build a python module to invert bounding box deltas and predict refined box coordinates from anchor boxes
build_clip_boxes_batch: build a python module to clip batched bounding box coordinates to image boundary limits
build_bbox_overlaps_batch: build a python module to compute batched IoU overlap between anchor boxes and ground truth boxes
